basis: Codex-assisted qualitative review of the first-round distinct records; full short texts or at most 500 normalized characters of longer texts. Not human-labelled ground truth, a sentiment model, or a representative sample.
useful_definition: Visible content describes a concrete product experience, usability problem, preference with context, or experience-linked feeling. Generic reactions, jokes, announcements, support explanations, advice and external references are separated. A bug report is useful software feedback but not automatically a negative sentiment label.
